text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a little concerned about the
swelling in your
legs. I think it would be
prudent to take some
time off to
recover.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I did a full examination, but there don't
appear to
be any serious issues. Let's just
keep an eye on
your progress for now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I've got forty unread messages on
LANE?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My Mom and Dad sent me way too many

messages...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I guess I should have expected it.
I was
suddenly hospitalized after
competing in the
Derby, after all.
choice_data_list: それだけ心配だったんだよ
choice_data_list_en: That's just how worried I was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's family came to cheer her on
during the
Derby, and they've already
been informed of the
situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I told them it wasn't anything serious,
and that I'd
stay by Ines's side while she
recovers. But they
still must have been
really worried.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's probably a good idea.
Seeing me in
person might put their
minds at ease.
choice_data_list: 今度、休むついでに帰省はどうだろう？
今度、休むついでに帰省はどうかな？
choice_data_list_en: Next time you take a break, why not visit home?
Next time you take time off, how about visiting home?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'm sure I'd be bored out of
my mind
while I rest my legs anyway.
choice_data_list: 久々に家で“お姉ちゃん”もしてきなよ
久々に家で“お姉ちゃん”もしてきたら？
choice_data_list_en: Go be a 'big sister' at home for a change.
Why don't you go be a 'big sister' at home for once?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And while I'm away, Trainer, I'm
counting on you
to come up with a
training routine for my next
race, the
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that decided, I submit a request for
leave to
the academy and have Ines
Fujin return home for
a week to rest up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't go eating anything weird while I'm
gone,
okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess I'll just have to trust you...

Okay, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look on until Ines Fujin's train has left
the
station.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I return to my office, I notice the
Derby
materials that I left strewn across
my desk are
neatly organized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit at my uncluttered desk and begin
thinking.
choice_data_list: ……アイネスが掃除してくれたのかな
choice_data_list_en: ...I wonder if Ines cleaned up for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is the final race of the
Classic
Triple Crown. At 3,000 meters,
it's truly a battle
of stamina. If Ines Fujin
is to have a chance...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...So you have concerns that her body
won't be
able to hold up?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I understand where you're coming from.
We at the
academy were also quite
worried about her
condition following
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
She'll need additional support. And not
just
physical—we also need to make sure
that she
remains mentally balanced.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Pushing her body to its limits
inevitably puts
strain on her mental
health, too.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over her with even more
care from
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A week passes by in the blink of an eye.
After an
examination at the hospital, it
appears we're
ready to return to training
without issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've got something reeeally
important to
tell you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin launches into discussion the
moment we
arrive at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So the thing is... I'm hoping to develop a
more
efficient running style for my
future races.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I mean... I collapsed after the
Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure that never happens
again. I
need a way to prevent myself
from becoming so
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd need to create a new
running
style! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her request is just what I had hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some Umamusume have extreme
difficulty trying
to alter the style they've
grown accustomed to.
That's why it
requires a long-term commitment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, if it helps alleviate the burden
she puts
on her body, then it's definitely
worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll leave the regimen changes
up to you!
choice_data_list: いいと思う！合宿でもやってみよう！
choice_data_list_en: Sounds great! Let's try it at the training camp too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully this will help my body stay
together and
lessen the time I spend
recovering.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Erm, Boss, I have something I need to
talk to you
about.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's up, Ines?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer is fast approaching, which
means we'll be
attending camp. I'll need
to come up with a new
training schedule
before then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's next goal is the Kikuka Sho.
